# Blip Toast

> Blip Toast is an MIT-licensed toast notification library for React Native. It offers five variants, toasts that follow a promise from loading to success or error, and a card you can restyle piece by piece or replace with your own layout. Mount one `<ToastContainer />`, then call `toast()` from anywhere — no provider or hook required.

Blip Toast is an open-source project by João Tambue. The official site has two pages: a short landing page and a documentation page with live examples (each example fires a real toast on the page). Both are available in English and Portuguese. Treat the GitHub repository as the source of truth for code, issues and releases, and the npm page for the published package.

Quick facts: install with `npm install blip-toast react-native-svg` (or `pnpm add`, `yarn add`, `bun add`; in Expo, `npx expo install blip-toast react-native-svg`). Requires `react` >= 18, `react-native` >= 0.72 and `react-native-svg` >= 13; Reanimated and Gesture Handler are not needed. Main API: `toast(message, options)`, `toast.success()`, `toast.error()`, `toast.warning()`, `toast.info()`, `toast.promise()`, `toast.update(id, options)`, `toast.dismiss(id)` and `toast.dismissAll()`. Container props: `position`, `theme`, `gap`, `offset`, `maxVisible`, `styles`, `slots`, `renderToast`. Toast options: `title`, `description`, `variant`, `duration`, `icon`, `action`, `onDismiss`, `fillColor`, `borderColor`, `borderWidth`, `preset`, `spring`, `bounce`, `timing`, `showTimestamp`, `showProgress`. The options `position` (per toast), `dismissible`, `swipeToDismiss`, `onPress`, `classNames` and `theme` (per toast) exist in the types but are not applied at runtime yet.

## Documentation
- [Homepage](https://blip-toast.vercel.app/): Landing page with a live demo and the three-step setup.
- [Documentation](https://blip-toast.vercel.app/docs/): Guides, live examples and the full API reference.
- [Installation](https://blip-toast.vercel.app/docs/#installation): Install command, Expo notes and requirements.
- [Quick start](https://blip-toast.vercel.app/docs/#quick-start): Mount the container and show a first toast.
- [Promises](https://blip-toast.vercel.app/docs/#promise): `toast.promise()` from loading to success or error.
- [Update & dismiss](https://blip-toast.vercel.app/docs/#update-and-dismiss): Toast handles, `toast.update()`, `toast.dismiss()` and `toast.dismissAll()`.
- [Positions](https://blip-toast.vercel.app/docs/#positions): Six container positions, safe-area offsets.
- [Custom layout](https://blip-toast.vercel.app/docs/#custom-layout): Replace the card with `renderToast` while keeping animation and timing.
- [API reference: ToastOptions](https://blip-toast.vercel.app/docs/#api-options): Every option with type and default.
- [API reference: ToastContainer](https://blip-toast.vercel.app/docs/#api-container): Container props with types and defaults.
- [Portuguese version](https://blip-toast.vercel.app/docs/?lang=pt): The documentation in Portuguese.

- [Changelog](https://github.com/joao-tambue/Blip-toast/blob/main/packages/blip-toast/CHANGELOG.md): Release history for the library.
